attackers_goals: Attackers may use this device file to create sockets though shell commands as part of a reverse shell.
description: Attackers may create a TCP stream using the shell command line to generate a reverse shell, enabling remote access to the endpoint.
investigative_actions: Review the command line used. Search for the corresponding network event. Check the prevalence of the target IP/domain.
name: A TCP stream was created directly in a shell
